newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest spot prods prices notionally steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest spot prods prices notionally steady.

text.p: U.S. Northwest product prices were notionally steady on Tuesday in thin talk, reacting to relatively quiet California markets and adequate supplies in local markets.
"There's plenty of barrels around," one trader said.
Olympic Pipeline will undergo brief repair work on Wednesday and Thursday, traders said, but prices already felt pressure on the news earlier this week.
Regular unleaded gasoline was assessed at 71.50 cents to 72 cents a gallon, off slightly from Monday.
Premium was seen 8.50 cents a gallon higher.
In distillates, jet fuel was notionally stable from late last week at 80/81 cents a gallon, while low-sulphur diesel stayed steady 81/83 cents, according to most traders.
